title: Airway and bronchoscopy decisions
synopsis: Recurrent pressure rise with patent tracheostomy and possible distal plug. Bronchoscopy is a decision, not a ritual. Episode 01: ep01-pressure-rise and consequence A/B/C.
openingNarrative: Pressures rise. Suction through a patent tracheostomy yields little. Rohan may scan RIGHT MIDDLE. Differential includes distal plug, atelectasis, secretions, inflammation. Pneumothorax is not diagnosed without findings. High-pressure recruitment risks ventricular instability.
clinicalState: Rising pressures. Reduced right air entry. Patent tracheostomy. Distal obstruction possible.
disabilityRightsNotes: Rohan reports location; family does not answer for him.

nodes.title: Name the differential before acting
nodes.openingNarrative: Before choosing a manoeuvre, the team lists differentials aloud at eye level with Rohan.
nodes.clinicalState: Uncertain airway cause. Cardiac reserve limited.

choices.label: Include Rohan’s scan in the differential discussion
choices.immediateConsequence: Access and authorship rise; proceeds to pressure-rise decision video.
choices.delayedConsequence: His report constrains later documentation language.

choices.label: Treat as pneumothorax without supporting findings
choices.immediateConsequence: Wrong pathway risk; unnecessary invasive steps possible.
choices.delayedConsequence: Continuity review flags diagnosis without findings.

choices.label: Order bronchoscopy automatically because it worked in the bay
choices.immediateConsequence: Ritualises a prior success; procedural risk rises without fresh indication talk.
choices.rohanAacLine: THE LAST EMERGENCY IS HISTORY. CHECK WHAT THIS ONE IS.

disabilityRightsNotes: Prior bay bronchoscopy success does not make every later scope mandatory.
